notes: Fixed the app's update checker failing every time with "Update check failed — check your connection.":the in-app fetch was cross-origin (app origin is https://localhost) and used the `cache` request header, which is NOT in the browser's CORS-safelisted set — so the WebView sent an OPTIONS preflight first,and GitHub Pages answers every OPTIONS with HTTP 405, killing the check before it ever reached the manifest. The fetch is now a plain cross-origin GET (which Pages serves with access-control-allow-origin:*, verified live),and the time-out grew 10s to 20s for slower networks. The manifest itself never advertised anything wrong — it is live and fresh (v56.0.20, zip fully uploaded, http 200, size matches).

Silent auto-checks (boot, every 30 min, on foreground) now behave sanely while music is playing:if they find an update they quietly remember it and wait — the install sheet only surfaces on a manual Check for updates,or on the next auto-check after the tune stops. Checking itself never touches audio,and the sheet + install can no longer pop up mid-song to reload the app and cut the tune.

Playback-aware install timing stays as-is:if you do accept an update while a song is playing,it waits for the song to pause or end (even backgrounded) before reloading — leaving the app can no longer kill the music, ever.
